Octopuses

Where are octopuses found around the world?

This data visualization shows octopus observations since 2000. Each species is shown in a unique color, and each dot represents a documented octopus observation in the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF). Drag the globe to explore, and use the slider and play button below to explore when and where each species has been seen.
